description: Update the design configuration for your GrowSurf program, including participant avatars under `participantAvatarStyle`, referred-visitor content such as the Claim Offer Popup and the side content of its GrowSurf page (`referredExperience.offerPageDescription` HTML, up to 5 `offerPageSteps` of `{ text, iconKey }`, and up to 3 `offerPageLinks` of `{ text, url }` where an empty `url` links to the Share URL), the website widget under `widget` (button or card, placement, timing, and visible pages), the participant Traffic report under `trafficInsights`, participant sign-in copy under `login`, payout-destination confirmation page copy under `payoutDestinationConfirmation`, and the participant Settings panel under `participantSettings`, such as the language picker's `languageSectionTitle` (up to 100 characters) and `languageSectionInstructionsText` (up to 255 characters). `trafficInsights.isPublicDisplayed` controls visibility; its labels cannot be blank. `participantAvatarStyle` accepts `CHARACTERS`, `INITIALS`, `ANIMALS`, or `GRADIENT`. `visualStyle` accepts `GLOW`, `CLEAN`, `FLAT`, `ROUND`, `TINT`, or `GLASS`; it sets corners, shadows, button shape and background on program pages and the GrowSurf Window. Changing it also fills `theme.buttons.borderRadius` and the `theme.globalBoxShadow` fields unless the same request sets them. Text fields use the same character limits as the dashboard Program Editor. Text the Program Editor requires, such as Window labels, button text, and status names, cannot be set to `null`, empty, or only spaces. Only supplied `fields` change; omitted fields retain their existing content and arrays replace wholesale. Targets `campaignId` if supplied, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_update_campaign_design

outputSchema.description: The full updated design configuration. Same shape as the `growsurf_get_campaign_design` result.

title: Update Program Design
